newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs target 135.20 ahead of correction.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs target 135.20 ahead of correction.

text.p: September BTPs may have slightly further to climb and could aim for 135.20 before a correction takes the contract lower, technical analysts said on Thursday.

"The contract looks positve still, even if small negative divergences are beginning to appear on intra-day charts, they don't look enough to push the contract down," said one analyst at an Italian bank in London.

He said the next target after Wednesday's high at 134.74, was 135.20, the 100 percent projection of the movement down from 131.90 to 128.60. "The 135.20 is where we could see some retracement," he said.
By 0757 GMT, September BTPs were up 0.04 at 134.62 after reaching a new all-time high on Wednesday at 134.74.
The analyst said if the market did correct, it would run into first support at 134.00,10. "But in the case of a major retracement, the lower boundary would be 133.60,40," he said.
Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking, said 135.25 was very much the upper limit to the contract.

"There comes a point when we have to have a correction. The Relative Strengh Indices are not seriously overbought yet, but we're beginning to get there. We're reaching the point where I can't see many attractions," he said.
Ostwald said any setback would bump into initial support at 133.70 to 133.85, the high from June 19 and the low from Wednesday.
"Then if it gets below that, it starts to go down very quickly, with the next genuine support at 133.17, the low from Tuesday," he said.
Ostwald said the longer term correction objective, assuming the market was nearing its peak, was at 132.40, the 38.2 percent retracement of the move from 128.60 on May 30 to 134.74 on Wednesday.
By 0815 GMT, September Eurolira was unchanged at 93.54.
